WITH t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) c FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM t) targeted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_distinct,

 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exp_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exp_keys,

 (SELECT max(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) mx

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_grain, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id,
 min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-14'

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_grain, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id,
 (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) dup_orders
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bdate, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
spend AS (
  SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) amt FROM lines WHERE bdate BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1),
tg AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT 'targeted' grp, count(*) n, SUM(COALESCE(s.amt,0)) tot, AVG(COALESCE(s.amt,0)) mean, count(s.member_id) buyers FROM tg LEFT JOIN spend s USING(member_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'holdout', count(*), SUM(COALESCE(s.amt,0)), AVG(COALESCE(s.amt,0)), count(s.member_id) FROM ho LEFT JOIN spend s USING(member_id)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bdate, s.store_id, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT (store_id=900) is_web, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) tot, min(net_amount) mn, max(net_amount) mx, sum(CASE WHEN bdate<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shifted,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM lines WHERE bdate BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'web lines w/o dispatched order' k, count(*) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-10' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'ST channel lines at store 900', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.channel_code='ST'
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff lines in window', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE staff_purchase_flag AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07'
